title: Balances:30 receipt,10 expense and another customer
goal: Write two own recorder sets and verify20, time boundaries and dimension isolation.
prerequisites: onec.p5; P1–P3; explicit contracts, types, collections and failure handling.
outcomes: Other sets retained; no whole-register overwrite.
sections: Dimensions say where; resources say how much

For service obligations, customer is a dimension and minutes a resource. Receipt 30 increases obligation; expense 10 reduces it. Sign follows business meaning, not whether an event is good or bad. Balance 20 derives from movements; manually maintaining it in a card too creates two sources of truth.

Add balance accumulation register Обязательства with Клиент: CatalogRef.Клиенты dimension and Минуты: Number(15,2) resource, selected among ЗаявкаУслуги movements. Keep Трудозатраты as turnover-kind; do not change an existing populated register’s kind.

Each movement links to a document, explaining the balance. Movement period and document date can have distinct meanings under configuration rules. A total screenshot without drill-down is insufficient. Preserve recorder identity and compare recorder-filtered sets when reposting.

Preparation creates an own customer/service and30/10 documents. The function writes receipt30 and expense10 using their recorder filters. A positive expense value with Expense direction reduces balance; do not also negate it without a different explicit contract.

After receipt 30 atD1, balance is 30; after expense 10 atD2, it is 20. Specify boundary inclusion and time precision. Period turnover and point-in-time balance are different quantities. Before the first movement, expect the agreed zero rather than a stale report result.

Expect20 on Nov3, no earlier rows on Nov1 and none for another own customer. These independently test arithmetic, time and dimensions. Do not compare against the whole infobase total. References and recorders trace every movement.

Opening+receipts−expenses=closing. Verify independently, then repost the receipt. A duplicated 30 must not turn 20 into 50. Add another customer and check dimension isolation. Prohibiting negative balance needs an explicit business rule and reliable concurrent checking inP10.

Expense11 is a compilable negative control yielding19 rather than20. Write(True) replaces the filtered recorder set; an incorrect/missing filter is dangerous. The code clears no entire register or earlier documents. Record created identities and work only in your copy.
